list.label: On start of scene
list.description: Runs once when the scene starts.

list.label: On end of scene
list.description: Runs once when the scene ends (changing or restarting scene).

list.label: Every tick
list.description: True every frame (about 60 times per second).

list.label: Every X seconds
list.description: True once every few seconds.

list.label: Compare variable
list.description: Compare a global or scene variable with a value.

list.label: Compare two values
list.description: Compare any two expressions, e.g. Player.x > 10.

list.label: Is true
list.description: True when the expression is true (or not 0).

list.label: Is between
list.description: True when a value is between min and max (inclusive).

list.label: Random chance
list.description: True randomly, e.g. 25 = one time in four.

list.label: Trigger once while true
list.description: Put last: the event runs only once each time the other conditions become true.

list.label: Group is active
list.description: True if the event group is active.

list.label: Repeat
list.description: Runs the actions and sub-events several times. Use loopIndex for the current number.

list.label: For
list.description: Repeats the rest of the event, counting from start to end (both included). Use loopindex("name") for the current number.

list.label: While
list.description: Repeats the rest of the event as long as the conditions after it are true (or until "Stop loop").

list.label: On timer finished
list.description: True at the moment a timer started with "Start timer" runs out.

list.label: Timer is running
list.description: True while a timer is counting down.

list.label: Compare scene time
list.description: Compare the seconds since the scene started.

list.label: Set variable
list.description: Change the value of a global or scene variable.

list.label: Add to variable
list.description: Increase a variable (text variables get the value appended).

list.label: Subtract from variable
list.description: Decrease a number variable.

list.label: Toggle variable
list.description: Flip a true/false variable.

list.label: Go to scene
list.description: Switch to another scene.

list.label: Restart scene
list.description: Start the current scene again from the beginning.

list.label: Wait
list.description: Pause the rest of this event (next actions and sub-events) for a while.

list.label: Show message
list.description: Show a short message on screen (handy for testing).

list.label: Log to console
list.description: Write a line to the debug console (🐞 button while playing) without showing it in the game. Great for checking that an event runs, e.g. "Clicked! score = " + Score.

list.label: Show alert
list.description: Pop up a message box and pause until it is closed. Use it for one-off checks, not every tick.

list.label: Call function
list.description: Run a function block (made with Add → Function) with values for its parameters.

list.label: Set return value
list.description: Inside a function: the value that Functions.Name(...) gives back.

list.label: Stop loop
list.description: End the loop this event is in (Repeat, For, For each, While) after the current repeat.

list.label: Set time scale
list.description: 1 = normal speed, 0.5 = slow motion, 2 = double speed.

list.label: Vibrate phone
list.description: A short buzz you can feel, great with Shake camera. Works on Android phones; ignored on desktop and iPhone.

list.label: Pause game
list.description: Freeze the game.

list.label: Resume game
list.description: Unfreeze the game.

list.label: Save value
list.hint: Keep a value on the device
list.description: Store a value on the device (kept after closing the game). Empty value = the variable with the same name as the key.

list.label: Load value
list.description: Read a saved value into a variable (nothing happens if it was never saved). Empty variable = same name as the key.

list.label: Set group active
list.description: Turn a group of events on or off.

list.label: Create object
list.description: Create a new object from a prefab (or copy of an object) at a position. It becomes picked for the next actions.

list.label: Start timer
list.description: Start a countdown. Use "On timer finished" to react when it ends.

list.label: Stop timer
list.description: Cancel a running timer.

list.label: Button is held
list.description: True while an on-screen button (or key) is held down.

list.label: On button pressed
list.description: True at the moment a button is pressed.

list.label: On button released
list.description: True at the moment a button is released.

list.label: On screen tapped
list.description: True when the player taps anywhere on the screen.

list.label: Screen is touched
list.description: True while a finger is on the screen.

list.label: On swipe
list.description: True when the player swipes in a direction.

list.label: Joystick is moving
list.description: True while the joystick (or WASD / arrows, or a gamepad stick) is pushed.

list.label: Joystick direction
list.description: True while the joystick is pushed in a direction.

list.label: Key is held
list.description: True while a keyboard key or gamepad button (PadA, PadB, PadX, PadY, PadLB, PadRB, PadLT, PadRT, PadStart…) is held.

list.label: On key pressed
list.description: True at the moment a keyboard key or gamepad button (PadA…) is pressed.

list.label: On collision with
list.description: Runs at the moment the object starts touching another object.

list.label: On collision ended
list.description: Runs at the moment two objects stop touching.

list.label: Is touching
list.description: True while the object touches (overlaps) another object.

list.label: Compare instance variable
list.description: Compare one of the object's own variables (e.g. hp).

list.label: Compare property
list.description: Compare position, angle, size or speed, e.g. Player y < -5.

list.label: Is on ground
list.description: True when a physics object is standing on something.

list.label: Is emitting particles
list.description: True while its Particles component is making new particles.

list.label: Is playing animation
list.description: True while the given model animation is playing.

list.label: On animation finished
list.description: Runs when a play-once animation (loop off) reaches its end. Leave the name empty for any animation.

list.label: Has line of sight to
list.hint: Can see it, no wall between
list.description: True when nothing solid (walls, crates…) is between the object and the target, e.g. an enemy only chases the player it can see. Triggers (checkpoints, coins) never block the view.

list.label: Is moving
list.description: True when the object's physics speed is above zero.

list.label: Is tweening
list.description: True while a tween of that property is still running.

list.label: Is visible
list.description: True if the object is shown.

list.label: Has tag
list.description: True if the object has a tag.

list.label: On tapped
list.description: Runs when the player taps this object on screen (also works for UI buttons).

list.label: On created
list.description: Runs when a new instance of the object is created.

list.label: On destroyed
list.description: Runs when an instance of the object is destroyed.

list.label: Distance to
list.description: Compare the distance between the object and the nearest other object.

list.label: Compare count
list.description: Compare how many of this object exist (or are picked).

list.label: Exists
list.description: True if at least one of these objects exists. Invert it for "no more coins".

list.label: Pick nearest
list.description: Only use the instance closest to another object.

list.label: Pick farthest
list.description: Only use the instance farthest from another object.

list.label: Pick random
list.description: Only use one random instance.

list.label: For each
list.description: Run the actions and sub-events once for every instance, one at a time.

list.label: Destroy
list.description: Remove the object from the game.

list.label: Spawn object
list.description: Create an object (prefab) at this object's position (+ offset). The new object becomes picked for the next actions.

list.label: Set position
list.description: Teleport the object. Self.x means "keep the current x".

list.label: Move by
list.description: Move the object by an amount (world axes). Multiply by dt for smooth per-second movement.

list.label: Move forward
list.description: Move in the direction the object is facing.

list.label: Move toward object
list.description: Move toward another object (speed in meters per second).

list.label: Move toward position
list.description: Move toward a point (speed in meters per second).

list.label: Set rotation
list.description: Set the rotation in degrees.

list.label: Set angle
list.description: Turn the object to face a direction (degrees around the vertical axis).

list.label: Rotate by
list.description: Turn the object by some degrees. Multiply by dt for smooth per-second rotation.

list.label: Look at
list.description: Turn the object to face another object.

list.label: Set size
list.description: Change the size (1 = normal).

list.label: Set visible
list.description: Show or hide the object.

list.label: Set enabled
list.description: A disabled object is hidden and stops moving/colliding.

list.label: Set color
list.hint: Tint it, e.g. red when hit
list.description: Change the object's color.

list.label: Set opacity
list.description: 1 = solid, 0 = invisible.

list.label: Tween
list.description: Smoothly animate position, angle, size or opacity to a value, e.g. size 1.5 with Back for a pop, or Self.y + 2 to rise. Starting another tween of the same property replaces it.

list.label: Stop tweens
list.description: Stop every running tween of the object where it is now.

list.label: Attach to
list.description: The object becomes a child of the target and moves with it, e.g. a key the player picked up. It stays where it is; use Set position afterwards to place it relative to the target (0, 0, 0 = the center of the target).

list.label: Detach
list.description: Let go of an attached object: it stays where it is and moves on its own again.

list.label: Set instance variable
list.description: Change one of the object's own variables.

list.label: Add to instance variable
list.description: Increase one of the object's own variables.

list.label: Subtract from instance variable
list.description: Decrease one of the object's own variables.

list.label: Set velocity
list.description: Set the physics speed on each axis (needs a Rigid body).

list.label: Push (impulse)
list.description: Give the object a sudden push (needs a Rigid body).

list.label: Apply force
list.description: Push continuously (use every tick; needs a Rigid body).

list.label: Jump
list.description: Jump up, only when standing on the ground (needs a Rigid body).

list.label: Set text
list.description: Change the text shown by a text object.

list.label: Set text
list.description: Change the text of an object with a Text component, e.g. "Score: " + Score.

list.label: Append text
list.description: Add text at the end of the current text.

list.label: Play animation
list.description: Play a clip of its 3D model, e.g. "walk", "jump" or "die". Loop off = play once and hold the last frame.

list.label: Stop animation
list.description: Stop the playing model animation.

list.label: Set animation speed
list.description: 1 = normal, 0.5 = half speed, 2 = double.

list.label: Burst particles
list.description: Shoot some particles at once, e.g. sparks on a hit or a puff on landing. Needs a Particles component.

list.label: Spawn particles here
list.description: Play a ready-made effect once where the object is, e.g. Sparkles when a coin is collected (works even if you destroy it right after). No Particles component needed.

list.label: Start particles
list.description: Start (or restart) its Particles component. One-shot effects like Explosion play again.

list.label: Stop particles
list.description: Stop making new particles. The ones already flying fade out normally.

list.label: Set particle rate
list.description: How many particles it makes per second, e.g. a bigger fire or a stronger engine trail.

list.label: Play its sound
list.description: Play the sound of the object's Audio component.

list.label: Stop its sound
list.description: Stop the sound of the object's Audio component.

list.label: Enable/disable behavior
list.description: Turn one of the object's behaviors on or off.

list.label: Set behavior setting
list.description: Change a behavior setting, e.g. platformer speed.

list.label: Add tag
list.description: Give the object a tag.

list.label: Remove tag
list.description: Remove a tag from the object.

list.label: On clicked
list.description: Runs when the player taps a UI button (e.g. Start, Pause, Retry).

list.label: Is held down
list.description: True while the player holds a UI button (e.g. a custom fire button).

list.label: Compare bar value
list.description: Compare the value of a progress bar, e.g. Health value ≤ 0.

list.label: Show
list.description: Show a UI element or a whole screen (and everything inside it).

list.label: Hide
list.description: Hide a UI element or a whole screen.

list.label: Show / hide
list.description: Show it if hidden, hide it if shown.

list.label: Set label
list.description: Change the text of a label or button, e.g. "Lives: " + Lives.

list.label: Set bar value
list.description: Set a progress bar value, e.g. health or time left.

list.label: Add to bar value
list.description: Add (or subtract with a negative number) to a progress bar. Stays between 0 and max.

list.label: Set bar maximum
list.description: Set the maximum of a progress bar.

list.label: Set image
list.description: Change the picture of an image, button or panel.

list.label: Set background color
list.description: Change the background color of a button, panel or bar.

list.label: Set text color
list.description: Change the text color of a label or button.

list.label: Set bar color
list.description: Change the fill color of a progress bar.

list.label: Play sound
list.description: Play a sound from your assets.

list.label: Stop sound
list.description: Stop a sound (leave empty to stop all sounds).

list.label: Set master volume
list.description: 0 = silent, 1 = full volume.

list.label: Shake camera
list.description: Shake the screen, great for hits and explosions.

list.label: Camera look at
list.description: Turn the main camera toward an object.

list.label: Set camera position
list.description: Move the main camera.

list.label: Spawn particles
list.description: Play a ready-made effect once at a position, e.g. an Explosion at Enemy.x, Enemy.y, Enemy.z. No object needed.
